svg.title: ApplicationSet scoping
svg.desc: The prod ApplicationSet selects overlays with the glob applications/*/*/overlays/prod. Two overlay directories match and become Applications; base directories, preview.yaml files, deeper paths, absent directories and unknown environments are ignored.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: One glob per environment is the entire selection logic. Membership is a directory, not a list.

svg.text: Add the directory and the Application appears on the next scan; delete it and the Application — and its workloads — are pruned.
